Message.MsgText: Unable to process the batch message because an unknown type was encountered: class name.

Explanation.p: The batch message contains an object that is neither request, nor response.

OperatorResponse.p: Edit the batch message so that it contains only requests or responses.

Message.MsgText: The Base64 decoding has not finished successfully for the entry with the following attributes: entry attributes.

Explanation.p: An exception occurred while decoding attributes

OperatorResponse.p: Check that the binaryAttributes parameter of the Parser is set correctly.

Message.MsgText: Unable to process the request because an unknown request type was received: class name.

Explanation.p: The request type is unknown to the Parser or the object is not a request at all.

OperatorResponse.p: Edit the batch message so that it contains only valid requests.

Explanation.p: The response type is unknown to the Parser or the object is not a response at all.

OperatorResponse.p: Edit the batch message so that it contains only valid responses.

Message.MsgText: Unable to complete the operation name request. The operation name request must contain exactly one <pso> element.

Explanation.p: The modify, lookup or delete request does not specify pso.

OperatorResponse.p: Edit the request in order to be compliant with the SPML v2 specification.

Message.MsgText: Unable to process the entry. The entry is missing required Attribute: attribute name.

Explanation.p: The SyncWeave Entry does not contain an Attribute that is required.

OperatorResponse.p: Add the missing Attribute to the SyncWeave Entry.

Message.MsgText: Unknown operation type: SPML v2 operation.

Explanation.p: The SPML v2 operation type is neither request, nor response.

OperatorResponse.p: Edit the SyncWeave Entry so that it represents a valid operation.

Message.MsgText: An error occurred while flushing the batch message: exception

Explanation.p: Refer to the exception message for more information.

OperatorResponse.p: Check the configuration of the Parser.

Message.MsgText: Unable to complete the operation name request. The operation name request must contain a <psoID ID> attribute.

Explanation.p: The modify, lookup, or delete request does not specify 'psoID ID' attribute correctly.

OperatorResponse.p: Edit the request in order to be compliant with the SPML v2 specification. Note that 'psoID ID' declaration is case sensitive.
